vectors.description: Every row accepted: publication decision is publish_all, the attempt reaches committed, accepted_count matches the row count.
A mix of accepted and rejected rows under publish_valid_rows: the accepted subset still commits, the rejected rows are recorded as quarantine evaluations rather than blocking the whole delivery.
The same mixed rows under all_or_nothing: a single rejected row rejects the whole delivery, so partial acceptance exists only where the contract admits it.
Every row rejected: publication_decision is reject_delivery, the attempt reaches failed, and no projection intent or outbox entry is ever staged -- the pre-intent failure rule.
The same manifest submitted twice claims the same digest: the second submit_managed call returns the identical attempt rather than creating a second one, and the delivery still commits once.

The same delivery_id is submitted twice with different row content (a different claim digest): the second submission is a conflicting claim, not a replay, and is rejected rather than silently accepted as a new attempt.
The contract declares sequence progress; the claim carries opaque_batch instead. Mode validation fails closed before any port beyond source_connector is touched.
The manifest declares a contract_digest that does not match the contract the runtime was given -- a stale plan/manifest pairing -- and is rejected before a claim digest is even computed.

The projection target rejects the first apply attempt (target_unavailable): the attempt lands commit_blocked with accepted progress already durable, then a due-evaluation resume applies the identical intent and reaches committed exactly once.

The projection target rejects every apply attempt: the outbox entry dispatches until the contract's max_attempts is reached and then dead-letters. The attempt stays commit_blocked with its accepted progress reserved and invisible, and no further due evaluation consumes it.
Landing preparation fails permanently (integrity_error) before any intent exists: the attempt reaches failed, accepted_progress is untouched and no outbox entry is staged.

Landing fails permanently (codec_error) at finish_materialization -- after the attempt has already transitioned to materializing. The attempt must be failed against the state it actually reached and the injected code must survive, rather than being masked by a stale_revision from failing against the revision landing started from. Still pre-intent, so no progress and no outbox entry.
The published schema interface is not ready: publication fails schema_invalid before the intent is built, so an unready schema never receives reserved progress.
The interface readiness was verified but has since been revoked: publication fails schema_invalid on the revocation instant alone, even though the result still reads ready.
A managed payload is submitted against a contract whose integration is external: the delivery input kind and the contract's integration must agree, so mode validation fails closed.
